patterns.name: Immutable State Updates
patterns.description: Always create new objects instead of mutating existing ones

patterns.name: Function Size Limit
patterns.description: Functions should be under 50 lines. Extract if larger.

patterns.name: File Size Limit
patterns.description: Files should be under 800 lines. Split if larger.

patterns.name: No Console Logs
patterns.description: Remove console.log before commit. Use proper logging.

patterns.name: Explicit Error Handling
patterns.description: All async operations must have try-catch or .catch()
